apps.localizedDescription: A six-week memory palace course, a working-memory gym, flashcards that schedule themselves (FSRS), reminders that keep nudging, and honest progress against your own baseline. Two looks: Midnight Den with Mochi the raccoon, and Gilded Atelier. General wellness only, not a medical device.
